title: Derived sections of the base-change unit square with independent universes
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\prime\to Y$ be arbitrary scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], and form their pullback with projections $f\prime,g_X$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Put $G_Z=R\Gamma_Z$ and let $c_h:Rh_*;G_{target}\cong G_{source};S_h$ be the fixed normalized Leray comparisons [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso]. Let $q:S_{g_X};S_f\cong S_{f\prime};S_g$ be the identity scalar-square comparison. Then $G_Y(\eta_g(Rf_*E));(c_g)_{Lg^*Rf_*E};S_g(G_{Y\prime}(BC_E);(c_{f\prime})_{Lg_X^*E})=(c_f)_E;S_f(G_X(\eta_{g_X}(E));(c_{g_X})_{Lg_X^*E});q_{G_{X\prime}(Lg_X^*E)}$, with $BC_E$ the canonical map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. No affine, quasi-coherence, flatness or invertibility hypothesis is made; the two localization universes are independent.

source.place: Remark 08HY (counit description of base change), Lemma 0D5T (canonical direct-image composition)

proof.text: Apply the abstract unit_mateEquiv identity twice, using iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv, to the canonical derived pullback-composition square. Unfold the fixed base-change map to identify its adjunct with that mate. This proves the sheaf-level unit square without any sections comparison.

Apply derived global sections to the sheaf-level unit square. The proved private categorical pasting lemma mixed_sections_paste combines naturality of mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g at base change, mixedSections_square_comparison_coherence at Lg_X* E, and naturality of mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso f at the g_X-unit, using functoriality and associativity. Instantiating that lemma gives the displayed equality without expensive repeated unfolding of the scheme-derived definitions.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean mate-unit and categorical naturality proof; normalized sections comparison coherence is split into a strictly smaller intermediate theorem. The private pasting helper keeps compilation below the single-file time limit.

lean.statement:
theorem mixedSectionsBaseChange_unit_square
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y).map
        ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)) ≫
      (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app
        ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y').map
            (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
              (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition E) ≫
          (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso (pullback.snd f g)).hom.app
            ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E)) =
      (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso f).hom.app E ≫
        (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction f).map
          ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections X).map
              ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction (pullback.fst f g)).unit.app E) ≫
            (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso (pullback.fst f g)).hom.app
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E)) ≫
        (schemeGlobalScalarSquareIso f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
          pullback.condition).hom.app
            ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections (pullback f g)).obj
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E))
